sloka: कौसल्या अपि तदा देवी रात्रिम् स्थित्वा समाहिता ।प्रभाते तु अकरोत् पूजाम् विष्णोह् पुत्र हित एषिणी ॥२-२०-१४॥
transliteration: kausalyā api tadā devī rātrim sthitvā samāhitā ।prabhāte tu akarot pūjām viṣṇoh putra hita eṣiṇī ॥2-20-14॥

translations.english: Having spent the night with a composed mind (abosorbed in meditation), Kausalya was worshipping lord Visnu in the early morning to secure her son's welfare.
